name: wspp
listed_description: A zero-dependency single-header, modern WebSocket client & server, ws/wss library.
reason: README (opened via raw.githubusercontent.com) and repo tree (tests/ has Autobahn echo client/server, unit tests for base64/sha1/utf8; playground/ has playg.cpp) hold no benchmark, no throughput or latency number and no comparison with websocketpp or any other library. Only claims are qualitative ('efficient single-threaded event loop', 'minimal overhead') plus Autobahn RFC 6455 conformance badges, which measure compliance, not speed. WebSearch for wspp vs websocketpp found no third-party benchmark. Repo has 31 stars, MIT, last commit 2026-01-11. Autobahn report pages live on pinwhell.github.io (blocked).

name: Wt
listed_description: A C++ library for developing web applications. (listed site https://www.webtoolkit.eu/wt)
reason: Wt (emweb/wt, 1.9k stars, GPL-2.0 with OpenSSL exception or commercial, last commit 2026-10-01) README and ReleaseNotes.md contain no speed claim or number. webtoolkit.eu, redmine.emweb.be, jacobfilipp.com (Dr. Dobb's article) and scitepress.org are unreachable (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND). WebSearch found only Emweb wiki pages on embedded ARM session start-up (hello 0.26 s, composer 0.69 s on a 200 MHz board; snippets only, not against any baseline) and anecdotal forum guesses; no head-to-head against PHP, Java, Rails or another framework. Wt is not among the TechEmpower FrameworkBenchmarks C++ frameworks (aeronet, cinatra, cppcms, drogon, oatpp, poco, userver, etc.).

name: zyre
reason: README says 'Zyre is fast and has low latency, requiring no consensus protocols' and 'Time for a new peer to join a network is about one second', with no method, no hardware and no comparison to any named library or protocol (directional claim plus one unbaselined number). No benchmark directory or comparison found in README, NEWS or the repo page. It is a peer-to-peer discovery and group-messaging library, not an HTTP server, so the guessed 'standard HTTP server' baseline does not apply. 952 stars, MPL-2.0, last commit 2026-08-19.
